title: ObjectKinematicTree allocates a vector in every evaluation of its mass matrix, forces and Jacobian
author: Claude-JG
description: Found with the allocation test of the implicit Runge-Kutta solvers (#3287): the kinematic tree of modelLibrary.py allocates 4 vectors per step with ExplicitEuler, 10 with RK44, 27 to 29 with the implicit solvers; ComputeMassMatrixAndODE2LHS initialized the LinkedDataVector of the joint velocities by a conditional expression, which copied it. Decided: q and q_t linked by LinkDataTo; a pytest of the allocations per step; revision2026c step RG20.7.5.
releaseNotes: ObjectKinematicTree links the joint coordinates and velocities without a copy and allocates no vector per evaluation of its mass matrix, forces and Jacobian; it allocated up to 29 per step of an implicit solver. test_kinematicTreeAllocations.py.
